title: Flow3D-OPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for 3D Geometry Generation with Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2609.07137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent image-to-3D generation models built on flow-matching diffusion Transformers (DiT) can produce high-fidelity meshes, yet their post-training strategy remains largely unexplored. There exist several critical bottlenecks in reinforcement learning: the inherent difficulty of defining comprehensive rewards for 3D geometric quality, and the gradient interference that arises when jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives. Inspired by the practicability of on-policy distillation (OPD) in large language models and image generation, we propose \textbf{Flow3D-OPD}, a two-stage post-training framework that introduces multi-teacher distillation into 3D geometry generation. In the first stage, we utilize the semi-policy to enhance the foundational capability of the pretrained model and then design an agentic verifier for 3D geometric quality evaluation. translated_title: Flow3D-OPD：基于流匹配扩散Transformer的3D几何生成的多教师在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于流匹配扩散Transformer（DiT）构建的图像到3D生成模型能够生成高保真度的网格，但其后训练策略在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。强化学习存在几个关键瓶颈：为3D几何质量定义全面奖励的固有困难，以及在联合优化异质目标时产生的梯度干扰。受在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在大语言模型和图像生成中实用性的启发，我们提出了Flow3D-OPD，这是一个将多教师蒸馏引入3D几何生成的两阶段后训练框架。在第一阶段，我们利用半策略来增强预训练模型的基础能力，随后设计了一个用于3D几何质量评估的智能体验证器。基于该验证器，我们可以通过直接偏好优化培养领域专用教师模型。
tldr: 提出Flow3D-OPD两阶段后训练框架，通过多教师在线策略蒸馏克服强化学习中奖励定义困难和梯度干扰问题，从而提升流匹配扩散Transformer生成高保真3D几何的能力。
en_tdlr: Flow3D-OPD introduces a two-stage multi-teacher on-policy distillation framework that overcomes reward definition difficulties and gradient interference in reinforcement learning, enhancing high-fidelity 3D geometry generation with flow-matching diffusion transformers.
